items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And I was playing there, with Zoot and Al Cohen.

ctx.x: And Zoot Sims and I, we get along like that. We're arguing and fussing with each other, just for the heck of it. It was Zoot Sims and Al Cohen. We were working down at the Halfnote. And Al Cohen came up and said to me, he said, 'It's time to go play.' And I'm talking to Zoot. And I turn around and say, 'Can't you see I'm talking over here?
What do you mean, coming over here and telling me let's go play, and caught him offguard and he looked at me and say, oh, excuse me, one of those things. And we'd just crack up.
